dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted a VA loan application to refinance my home for $175,000 over 360 months. Could you please tell me the status or outcome of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still being reviewed?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your inquiry. Your VA loan application for refinancing has been approved and the loan was originated. If you have any additional questions about your loan terms or details, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know that my loan was approved! Can you tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of the loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your approved loan has an interest rate of 6.25%. The total loan costs are $1,612.34. If you would like details on other aspects of your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the details. Could you please tell me if my loan is considered high-cost (HOEPA) or if it has a negative amortization feature? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have a negative amortization feature. After origination, your loan was sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Just to clarify, what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? And what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is the percentage of your total monthly debt payments compared to your total monthly income. However, your loan record does not include a DTI ratio value. You were approved for a VA first lien loan product.
